name: Ding! Arcadia Fun-Time Clock-In Essentials
description: Calling all explorers! Furbobocom has put together "Planarcadia Essentials" just for you. Let your urban adventure begin!
introduction:
◆ Summary ◆
Calling all explorers! Furbobocom has put together "Planarcadia Essentials" just for you. Let your urban adventure begin!

◆ Event Rules ◆
During the event, Trailblazers can view everything on the Clock-In Essentials list.
Complete the designated items in "Planarcadia" to claim your rewards from the corresponding page.

◆ Event Rewards ◆
Completion rewards of any type can only be obtained once during the event period.
